items.topic: Does a long-resident foreigner get the USD 50,000 annual quota?
items.gap: Three texts pull in different directions. The Individual FX Measures define a 境内个人 as a Chinese citizen holding a resident, military or armed-police ID, and a 境外个人 as a passport, HK-Macau permit or Taiwan permit holder, so a US passport holder is an overseas individual. The FX Regulation, for its own terms, counts a foreigner who has continuously resided in China for one year as a 境内个人. SAFE's 2024 Q&A gives the annual facilitation quota only to holders of a Foreign Permanent Resident ID Card.
items.action: Assume the documented route unless you hold the permanent-resident card, and ask the bank which definition its system applies.
